newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper drops, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper drops, other metals steady.

text.p: Indian copper prices fell sharply on Thursday, while other base metals remained steady in thin trading, dealers said.
Copper dropped 150 rupees to 13,350 rupees per quintal as losses in the world market prompted panic selling.
Zinc was quiet at 8,400 rupees, as was lead at 4,200 rupees, with volumes low as major players awaited the announcement of producer selling prices for August.
"Hindustan Zinc Ltd. is likely to hike selling prices for August while Hindustan Copper Ltd. may keep prices unchanged or may reduce them," said Sharad Parikh, a leading dealer.
Tin and nickel prices consolidated their recent gains on stray industrial support.
Tin was steady at 29,200 rupees per quintal after gaining 100 on Wednesday, while nickel was steady at 34,300 rupees per quintal after gaining 200 rupees on Wednesday.
Trade in aluminium was quiet at 7,800 rupees per quintal, but the market undercurrent was firm on expectations that local producers may hike prices for August.
